text_block_list.text:
In the gymnasium, I ran into Fine Motion 
and Durandal practicing fencing. Nearby, a 
horse girl in a suit was standing guard—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Her Highness Fine Motion has practiced 
fencing ever since her days back in her 
homeland.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Even now, she spars with her 
friends like this to refresh her spirits.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Magnificent, Fine-san. Even from my 
perspective, you have truly improved.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then that means I can reach even 
greater heights, desu wa! Would you grant 
me a serious duel?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...?! Please wait, Your Highness. 
Durandal-sama is a seasoned expert. There 
is a risk you may get injured...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Captain. I understand what you wish to 
say. However, I wish to know the true 
measure of my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It is necessary for me. Please, I ask of 
you.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. However, please grant us 
permission to step in and stop the match 
if an emergency arises.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: Prêts?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Oui.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Allez!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Haah! —...Kh, hah!

In an instant, a fierce offensive and 
defensive battle erupted. The boundary 
between teacher and student was no longer 
present—!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...! Your Highness, what a sharp 
thrust...! She is entirely different from 
her days back at the castle!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
To keep up with Durandal-sama's movements 
as well... When did she attain such 
remarkable skill...?!
choice_data_list:
Her reflexes and dynamic visual acuity 
must have improved.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fine-san... truly impressive. To think 
your skill has advanced to this degree!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With who I am now—I can do it. I shall 
meet the strike of the Holy Sword head-on, 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely...! With utmost sincerity 
and resolve, here I come—!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!! Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew... so close. You truly are 
formidable, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...To deflect my full-powered strike is 
proof of exceptional skill on your part as 
well. Calling it mere "self-defense" 
almost feels like a waste.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because it is 
self-defense, desu wa. —So that I may act 
freely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I wish to experience many things 
in this country, I personally requested 
that my security detail be scaled back 
compared to when I was back home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must be able to protect 
myself by my own hand! If only so that I 
do not cause trouble for everyone else, 
yes?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...So you trained with such resolve in 
mind. —Then, if I may be so bold, Your 
Highness. Allow me to continue assisting 
you from this day forth!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...What had I been looking at all this 
time? To be right at her side, yet fail to 
realize something like this...!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
This was never a mere "pastime." She has 
been disciplining herself with a far 
deeper, broader perspective...!

The guard captain is deeply moved. Her 
subordinates also voice their heartfelt 
praise for Fine Motion one after another.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A sovereign whom her retainers wish to 
serve from the bottom of their hearts... 
Ah, what a magnificent sight.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say. To serve a master with 
such an unyielding drive for 
self-improvement fills me with pride as a 
retainer.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
We, too, must redouble our devotion. 
Starting from today's training, we shall 
implement even stricter measures.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please do not push yourselves too 
hard, all right? It would be terrible if 
anyone got injured, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, if that is how you feel... I must 
continue to grow even further, so that I 
may remain worthy of you all!
choice_data_list: It's wonderful to have such ambition!
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, if that is how you feel... I must 
continue to grow even further, so that I 
may remain worthy of you all!
choice_data_list: It's wonderful to have such ambition!
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Right now, I would love to 
learn much more about how everyday 
citizens live, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please leave the selection 
of observation sites to us. We shall 
choose the optimal locations for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Captain. Fufu, let's 
make this a very meaningful time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Taking breaks is important, isn't it! 
Fufu, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I want to do my absolute best. 
For everyone's sake, and for mine as well!
